committee: * Presentation Notice for Legislative Certificate No. 373-38 -Office of Legislative Secretary Senator Sabrina Salas Matanane (COR)
title: Håfa Adai, Please join me in presenting Legislative Certificate No. 373-38 (COR), recognizing the Guam Memorial Hospital (GMH) Volunteers Association honorees during their Recognition and Awards Ceremony for their dedication, service, and commitment to the people of Guam. The presentation is scheduled for Thursday, May 7, 2026, at 11:00 a.m., at the Hyatt Regency Ballroom in Tumon. For more information about the presentation, contact the Office of Legislative Secretary, Senator Sabrina Salas Matanane, at 671-989-2572 or via email at office.senatorbri@ guamlegislature.gov . ### END OF MEMORAND…
